action_network.note: No published OpenAPI; OSDI/HAL docs only

active_campaign.note: ReadMe-hosted v3 spec; per-account host {account}.api-us1.com; docs site rate-limits non-browser requests

acuity_scheduling.note: Vendor ReadMe registry spec is partial (7 paths, :id style params); OAuth2 uses Bearer

adalo.note: Per-app collection API; no published spec

affinity.note: Spec covers v2 only (Bearer); n8n node uses v1 with basic auth (key as password), which has no spec

agile_crm.note: No published spec; per-tenant {domain}.agilecrm.com, basic auth email:apiKey

airtable.note: Official OpenAPI extracted from the public developer documentation; includes Web API and SCIM operations.

alibaba_cloud.note: DashScope OpenAI-compatible mode; no vendor spec found, regional hosts

anthropic.note: Pinned SDK specification includes stable and beta request variants. Public availability and admin credentials need review per operation; anthropic-version remains part of reviewed request contracts.

azure_aisearch.note: Pinned to api-version 2024-07-01 used by n8n; newer combined search.json exists

azure_cosmos_db.note: Cosmos SQL data-plane REST not in azure-rest-api-specs (Tables only); auth is an HMAC-signed token

azure_open_ai.note: Deployment-style API (api-version) plus /openai/v1 API; per-resource host

azure_storage.note: Blob service only, x-ms-version 2021-12-02 as n8n uses; shared-key auth is HMAC-signed (SharedKey prefix)

bannerbear.note: Spec covers v5; n8n node calls /v2 which has no spec

bitwarden.note: Public API swagger only embedded in bitwarden.com/help/api page or self-hosted /api/docs; no stable URL

bubble.note: Per-app Data API; swagger only per app when enabled

cal.note: Self-hosted instances use their own host

chargebee.note: Product Catalog 2.0 spec; PC1.0 sites use chargebee_api_v2_pc_v1_spec.json

chroma_db.note: Cloud or self-hosted; served live by the Chroma server

cisco_webex.note: Messaging and meetings only, matching the n8n node

citrix_adc.note: NITRO API has no public spec; NextGen API YAML only downloadable from appliance GUI

clearbit.note: No published spec; API sunset under HubSpot

clockify.note: Spec has no servers; paths are relative to /api; reports API uses reports.api.clockify.me

coda.note: Spec rebranded Superhuman Docs with servers docs.superhuman.com/apis/v1; n8n uses coda.io/apis/v1

confluence.note: Covers Confluence v2/v1 and Jira platform; OAuth calls go via api.atlassian.com/ex/{product}/{cloudId}; Jira Server differs

contentful.note: No official OpenAPI or raw Postman JSON; only third-party profiles exist.

convert_kit.note: Spec is Kit v4; n8n uses v3 (api.convertkit.com, api_secret query param) which has no spec.

copper.note: Only an official Postman collection; no OpenAPI.

cortex.note: TheHive Cortex publishes no machine-readable spec.

customer_io.note: Basic (site_id:api_key) is for Track API; App API uses Authorization: Bearer; EU hosts are track-eu/api-eu.

databricks.note: Databricks publishes no official OpenAPI; only community-scraped specs.

deep_l.note: Free plan uses https://api-free.deepl.com with the same paths.

deep_seek.note: No official spec; API is OpenAI-compatible at https://api.deepseek.com.

demio.note: No spec found; Demio also requires an Api-Secret header.

dhl.note: Vendor URL has a dated path and may change with new versions.

discourse.note: An Api-Username header is also required.

drift.note: No public spec file found; product is being sunset by Salesloft.

dropbox.note: Official spec is in Stone format (github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec), not OpenAPI.

egoi.note: Spec taken from the vendor's Java SDK repo.

elastic_security.note: Kibana spec (~10MB); API key auth uses Authorization: ApiKey <key>.

emelia.note: GraphQL API with no published SDL; introspection needs an API key.

erp_next.note: Frappe ships no OpenAPI; only unofficial community specs.

eventbrite.note: No public spec file; origin https://www.eventbriteapi.com.

facebook.note: Meta publishes no Graph API spec.

facebook_graph_api.note: Meta publishes no Graph API spec.

facebook_lead_ads.note: Meta publishes no Graph API spec.

figma.note: OAuth tokens use Authorization: Bearer instead.

filemaker.note: Data API docs are served per server only; bearer is a session token from /sessions.

form_io.note: Postman documenter export from apidocs.form.io; projects use per-project or self-hosted hosts.

formstack.note: Spec covers /api/v2025 while n8n calls /api/v2; URL returns JSON despite .yaml name.

freshdesk.note: Freshworks publishes no OpenAPI for Freshdesk.

freshservice.note: No official spec; basic auth with API key as username.

ghost.note: No official spec; Admin API uses a JWT, Content API uses ?key= query.

github.note: Spec is ~13MB; GHES users have their own host.

gitlab.note: Auto-generated spec does not yet cover the full REST API; self-managed uses own host.

gong.note: Each customer gets its own api.gong.io base URL.

gotify.note: App token for sending messages, client token for management.

grist.note: Host is per team (X.getgrist.com) or self-hosted.

groq.note: No public spec URL; Groq is OpenAI-compatible at api.groq.com/openai/v1 and its spec is only embedded in SDK repos.

gumroad.note: No vendor spec; only an unofficial community spec (flowoid/gumroad-openapi).

halo_psa.note: Each tenant serves Swagger UI at {tenant}/api/swagger, but no public JSON URL was found; the token comes from an OAuth client-credentials flow.

harvest.note: No vendor spec; requests also need a Harvest-Account-Id header. Community generator: jolicode/harvest-openapi-generator.

help_scout.note: No public machine-readable spec for the Inbox API v2.

high_level.note: v2 API only. The legacy v1 API at rest.gohighlevel.com has no spec. Requests also need a Version header.

home_assistant.note: No published OpenAPI for the Home Assistant REST API; self-hosted.

hubspot.note: v3 specs only. n8n also calls legacy v1/v2 endpoints (engagements, forms submissions on api.hsforms.com) that these specs do not cover.

hugging_face_inference.note: Covers the Hub API only. Inference (router.huggingface.co, OpenAI-compatible) has no published spec.

hunter.note: The spec also accepts an X-API-KEY header or a Bearer token.

intercom.note: Pinned to API version 2.11; newer version folders exist in the repo.

invoice_ninja.note: v5 API. The hosted service is invoicing.co; self-hosted instances use their own host. The n8n node also supports the v4 API.

jenkins.note: Jenkins has no OpenAPI; self-hosted. Basic auth is username plus API token.

jina_ai.note: DeepSearch (deepsearch.jina.ai, OpenAI-compatible) has no public spec; its openapi.json needs auth.

jot_form.note: No public spec. The host depends on the account (api.jotform.com, eu-api, hipaa-api).

keap.note: Covers REST v2 only (/crm/rest/v2). n8n uses REST v1 (/crm/rest/v1), which has no public spec. The spec server is api.keap.com.

ko_bo_toolbox.note: The server is kf.kobotoolbox.org, eu.kobotoolbox.org or self-hosted.

lemlist.note: Basic auth with an empty username and the API key as the password.

lemonade.note: Local OpenAI-compatible server with no published OpenAPI file; self-hosted.

line.note: LINE Notify was discontinued in March 2025 and never had a spec.

linked_in.note: LinkedIn publishes no OpenAPI. Requests also need LinkedIn-Version and X-Restli-Protocol-Version headers.

magento2.note: Admin REST schema for 2.4.9, basePath /rest/default. Large spec.

mailer_lite.note: No vendor spec. The Classic API (api.mailerlite.com) uses the X-MailerLite-ApiKey header instead.

mailjet.note: The SMS API (Bearer token) may not be fully covered.

mandrill.note: The API key goes in the JSON body field 'key', not a header. The spec basePath is /api/1.3 but n8n uses /api/1.0.

mattermost.note: The bundled OpenAPI is only a build artifact; the repo holds unbundled YAML fragments (mattermost/mattermost api/v4/source).

mautic.note: No public spec. The API Platform v2 docs exist only on each instance's /api/v2.

medium.note: The APIs.guru medium.com entry is an unofficial RapidAPI wrapper. The official API is deprecated and has no spec.

message_bird.note: Covers SMS messages only. The /balance endpoint that n8n uses is not covered.

metabase.note: Spec is from the master branch; self-hosted.

microsoft_excel_share_point.note: Graph documents no /sites/{site}/drive workbook routes; SharePoint workbooks are reached through their drive id

milvus.note: No vendor-hosted OpenAPI URL for the RESTful v2 API was found.

mindee.note: v1 API spec served by the API host; spec declares bearer JWT but API keys use 'Token <key>'; v2 spec at api-v2.mindee.net/openapi.json

minimax.note: docs publish one spec per product area; video spec only covers query/retrieve, image spec has no paths

misp.note: self-hosted; spec from MISP repo default branch

mocean.note: no public spec found; key and secret are sent as mocean-api-key and mocean-api-secret params

monica_crm.note: no spec in monicahq repo or docs; hosted at app.monicahq.com or self-hosted

motorhead.note: no spec for Metal's hosted Motorhead API; getmetal/motorhead repo has none

msg91.note: no public OpenAPI or raw Postman JSON found

n8n.note: self-hosted; spec uses relative $refs to sibling files in the repo, base path /api/v1

nasa.note: only APOD covered; APIs.guru 'asteroids neows' entry actually contains the TechPort spec, so it is skipped; no spec for DONKI/Earth/etc.

next_cloud.note: self-hosted; OCS specs only, WebDAV file operations (PROPFIND/MKCOL/MOVE under /remote.php/webdav) are not covered

noco_db.note: self-hosted or app.nocodb.com; v1/v2/v3 APIs in separate files

notion.note: no official spec (developers.notion.com/openapi.json serves an unrelated spec); APIs.guru copy is old and has only 8 paths; Notion-Version header required

npm.note: official spec is split into path fragments (no openapi header) merged via api/merge-config.yaml; package metadata GET /{pkg} and dist-tags are not described

nvidia.note: no standalone NVIDIA spec; NIM is OpenAI-compatible under /v1, so the OpenAI spec is used with an include filter; credential url can point to self-hosted NIM

odoo.note: self-hosted JSON-RPC (/jsonrpc) and JSON-2 (/json/2/<model>/<method>) APIs; no static spec, models vary per instance

onfleet.note: official Postman workspace exists but raw collection JSON needs a Postman API key; ReadMe docs expose no single spec

open_ai.note: credential url may point to an OpenAI-compatible host

open_router.note: Official OpenAPI, including /api/v1 and /api/alpha/decisions. Multipart file uploads and transcriptions remain unsupported. Some endpoints require a management key or programme access.

open_weather_map.note: no vendor or APIs.guru spec; only community specs exist

orbit.note: Orbit has shut down; spec kept for completeness

oura.note: URL is versioned and changes on releases; current link is on cloud.ouraring.com/v2/docs

paddle.note: n8n uses Paddle Classic (vendors.paddle.com/api/2.0, vendor_id + vendor_auth_code in POST body); PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi covers only Paddle Billing

pay_pal.note: token from client-credentials exchange at /v1/oauth2/token; sandbox is api-m.sandbox.paypal.com; other product specs in same repo

peekalink.note: no public spec; tiny API (POST / with link)

phantombuster.note: vendor-published v2 spec in phantombuster/public-gists; may lag the docs

philips_hue.note: no public spec for the Hue remote API (api.meethue.com)

pinecone.note: data plane runs on per-index hosts (*.svc.pinecone.io); specs are dated by API version

pipedrive.note: v1 under /v1, v2 under /api/v2; OAuth uses company domain hosts

plivo.note: no public spec found; Auth ID/Auth Token as basic auth

post_hog.note: ~9 MB spec of the private /api/ endpoints; public capture endpoints used by n8n (/capture, /batch) are not in it; US/EU cloud or self-hosted

postmark.note: account API uses X-Postmark-Account-Token instead of the server token

profit_well.note: no public spec; ProfitWell is now part of Paddle

pushbullet.note: no public spec; Access-Token header also accepted

pushcut.note: Vendor-certified Power Platform connector spec; Pushcut publishes no standalone OpenAPI file

pushover.note: No vendor spec; only a third-party Power Platform connector exists. Token also accepted as a form body field

qdrant.note: Self-hosted or Qdrant Cloud cluster URL

quickbase.note: Vendor spec from developer.quickbase.com, mirrored in a third-party repo; also needs QB-Realm-Hostname header

quickbooks.note: Intuit states it has no OpenAPI file; Postman collections are only in the Postman workspace, with no public raw JSON

rabbitmq.note: n8n uses AMQP; management HTTP API has only a third-party OpenAPI spec

raindrop.note: No vendor spec; unofficial spec at lasuillard/raindrop-client openapi.yaml

reddit.note: No official machine-readable spec; OAuth calls go to oauth.reddit.com

rocketchat.note: Spec is split by area; other area files exist in the same repo

rundeck.note: Vendor spec lives in the rundeck/go-rundeck SDK repo; paths are versioned (/api/{v}/...)

s3.note: AWS SigV4 signing, which cannot be expressed as a header/query/basic rule; the n8n node targets any S3-compatible endpoint

salesforce.note: The OpenAPI file is generated per org (beta); the forcedotcom Postman repo is archived and has no collection JSON

salesmate.note: Also needs x-linkname header (the account domain); older endpoints use sessionToken

sea_table.note: Default branch is versioned (v6.2) and changes with releases; the API token is exchanged for a base token that is sent as Bearer; self-hosted domains possible

sear_xng.note: Self-hosted; no published spec and no auth by default

segment.note: No machine-readable spec for the tracking API (api.segment.io/v1); the write key is the basic-auth username

send_grid.note: OpenAPI 3.1, split per product; other areas exist in spec/json

sendy.note: Self-hosted with no spec; api_key goes in the POST form body

sentry_io.note: Self-hosted Sentry and regional hosts (us.sentry.io, de.sentry.io) also possible

service_now.note: Specs are exported per instance from the REST API Explorer; no public file, only community specs

shopify.note: n8n uses legacy REST Admin with no official spec; the GraphQL Admin schema can only be fetched by POST introspection at shopify.dev/admin-graphql-direct-proxy/{version}

signl4.note: n8n uses the webhook /webhook/{teamSecret} (secret in path), which is not in the REST spec; the REST API uses the X-S4-Api-Key header

slack.note: Official current Web API method documentation, indexed by the vendor sitemap; each page has a content hash. SCIM, Audit Logs, and Legal Holds are separate API families.

exclusions.Events API: Inbound event payloads are outside outgoing request recognition.
exclusions.SCIM, Audit Logs, Legal Holds: Separate HTTP API families with no configured descriptor source yet.

snowflake.note: n8n uses the SQL driver, so the SQL API is the closest HTTP match; JWT/PAT tokens also need the X-Snowflake-Authorization-Token-Type header

splunk.note: Splunk confirms there is no OpenAPI spec for the Enterprise REST API

storyblok.note: No official spec (vendor issue open). Auth shown is for the Management API; the Content API uses the ?token= query

strapi.note: Self-hosted; the OpenAPI file is generated per project by the documentation plugin

supabase.note: PostgREST spec is generated per project at /rest/v1/ and needs the apikey; the Management API spec (api.supabase.com/api/v1-json) is not what n8n uses

survey_monkey.note: Certified Power Platform connector, partial coverage; its host is api.surveymonkey.net

syncro_msp.note: Per-tenant X.syncromsp.com; spec also allows the api_key query

taiga.note: No published spec; the token comes from POST /api/v1/auth

telegram.note: Bot token goes in the path (/bot{token}/method); the APIs.guru spec is old (Bot API 5.0)

the_hive.note: TheHive 5 spec (StrangeBee); the n8n node targets older /api/case endpoints that may be missing from it

the_hive_project.note: Spec is TheHive 5.8 (API v1); n8n node also uses deprecated v0 endpoints.

todoist.note: Official unified API v1 spec; paths carry /api/v1 prefix.

toggl.note: URL is a content-hashed Docusaurus asset linked from engineering.toggl.com/docs/track/openapi/ and will change on updates; spec host says localhost.

travis_ci.note: No published OpenAPI for API v3; also requires Travis-API-Version: 3 header.

trello.note: Auth needs both key and token query params; OAuth1 alternative.

twake.note: n8n uses a bespoke plugins.twake.app/plugins/n8n endpoint; no public spec.

twilio.note: Split per product; kept Core 2010 API (SMS/calls) and Events (trigger).

twist.note: Only HTML docs at developer.twist.com/v3; no machine-readable spec found.

twitter.note: n8n also calls api.twitter.com and upload.twitter.com (v1.1 media upload), not in v2 spec.

typeform.note: Official Typeform Postman collection linked from their developer docs; no public OpenAPI.

unleashed_software.note: No public spec; requests also need HMAC api-auth-signature header.

uplead.note: No public spec found; raw API key in Authorization header.

uproc.note: No public spec found; basic auth with email:apiKey.

uptime_robot.note: Spec is API v3 (Bearer); n8n uses legacy v2 POST endpoints with api_key in body.

url_scan_io.note: Redocly bundle download URL from docs.urlscan.io; includes Pro endpoints.

venafi_tls_protect_cloud.note: ReadMe-hosted docs expose no downloadable spec without login; regional hosts api.venafi.cloud/.eu etc.

venafi_tls_protect_datacenter.note: WebSDK OpenAPI is served only by each customer's TPP instance; no public copy.

vercel_ai_gateway.note: No Vercel gateway spec; gateway is OpenAI-compatible under /v1, so OpenAI's spec filtered to those paths.

vero.note: No public spec; auth_token sent in JSON body or query.

vonage.note: SMS API only (what n8n uses); n8n sends api_key/api_secret in body instead of basic.

weaviate.note: REST only; client may also use gRPC.

webflow.note: Data API v2; n8n legacy mode uses v1 which is not covered.

whats_app.note: Meta business messaging spec covers WhatsApp messages/media; filename is version-pinned and may be replaced.

wise.note: Spec server is api.wise.com/2026Q4 with unversioned paths; n8n uses api.transferwise.com /v1,/v3 paths.

wolfram_alpha.note: Covers only llm-api and cloud-plugin; api.wolframalpha.com v1 simple/short-answer endpoints not described.

woo_commerce.note: No official spec; only community OpenAPI ports of wc/v3.

wordpress.note: No official OpenAPI; WP REST API self-describes via /wp-json discovery index only.

workable.note: No public spec found for spi/v3.

xai_grok.note: Official spec served by xAI; OpenAI-compatible plus native endpoints.

xata.note: n8n uses legacy Xata serverless DB API (xata.sh); current xataio/xata specs are for the new Postgres platform.

xero.note: Accounting API only (n8n scope); also needs xero-tenant-id header.

zammad.note: Zammad publishes no OpenAPI (open feature request); basic auth also supported.

zendesk.note: Support API spec; per-tenant X.zendesk.com; basic is email/token:apiToken, OAuth uses Bearer.

zep.note: First spec has legacy sessions/collections used by n8n; second is current threads API; self-hosted Zep differs.

zoho_crm.note: Specs are v8 (n8n uses /crm/v2); host varies by data center (.eu, .in, ...).

zoom.note: Meetings API spec (covers meetings and webinars); other products are separate api-hub specs.

zulip.note: Basic auth with email:apiKey; per-org or self-hosted host.
